test_BaseOT_send_receive: test the BaseOT class send and receive methods for oblivious transfer between two processes
test_ObliviousTransfer_multi_process: test the TestObliviousTransfer class that runs BaseOT in a multi-process environment with sender and receiver roles
run_BaseOT_unit_test: run the unittest for BaseOT oblivious transfer primitive to verify send and receive correctness
review_BaseOT_send: review the BaseOT send method that transmits two message lists to a receiver process
review_BaseOT_receive: review the BaseOT receive method that retrieves selected messages using choice bits from the sender
